name: Vehicle-km travelled, AM
definition: Sum of link volume x length for user_class ALL in the AM period. SQL: SELECT SUM(f.volume * l.length_m / 1000.0) AS value FROM link_flows f JOIN links l USING (link_id) WHERE f.period = 'AM' AND f.user_class = 'ALL'

name: Share of links with V/C above 1.0, AM
definition: Links with vc_ratio > 1.0 divided by all links carrying flow, AM, user_class ALL. SQL: SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN vc_ratio > 1.0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS value FROM link_flows WHERE period = 'AM' AND user_class = 'ALL' AND volume > 0

name: Volume-weighted congested speed, AM
definition: Sum(volume x congested speed) / Sum(volume) for AM, user_class ALL. SQL: SELECT SUM(volume * cong_speed_kph) / NULLIF(SUM(volume), 0) AS value FROM link_flows WHERE period = 'AM' AND user_class = 'ALL'

name: Total demand trips, AM
definition: Sum of all DEMAND matrix cells in the AM period, all purposes and modes. SQL: SELECT SUM(trips) AS value FROM od WHERE matrix_kind = 'DEMAND' AND period = 'AM'

name: PT mode share, AM
definition: PT demand trips divided by all demand trips, AM. SQL: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN mode = 'PT' THEN trips ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(trips), 0) AS value FROM od WHERE matrix_kind = 'DEMAND' AND period = 'AM'

name: Mean trip length, all periods
definition: Trip-weighted mean of the DIST skim (metres, per data contract 8.3) over DEMAND matrix cells, converted to km. SQL: SELECT SUM(o.trips * s.value) / NULLIF(SUM(o.trips), 0) / 1000.0 AS value FROM od o JOIN skims s ON s.skim_kind = 'DIST' AND s.mode = o.mode AND s.period = o.period AND s.origin = o.origin AND s.destination = o.destination WHERE o.matrix_kind = 'DEMAND'

name: Road network length
definition: Sum of link length over all highway links (each direction counted). SQL: SELECT SUM(length_m) / 1000.0 AS value FROM links

name: Lane-km, all roads
definition: Sum of link length x lanes over all highway links. SQL: SELECT SUM(length_m * lanes) / 1000.0 AS value FROM links

name: Lane-km, freeways
definition: Sum of link length x lanes over links of class FWY. SQL: SELECT SUM(length_m * lanes) / 1000.0 AS value FROM links WHERE link_class = 'FWY'

name: Total demand trips, all periods
definition: Sum of all DEMAND matrix cells, every purpose, mode and period. SQL: SELECT SUM(trips) AS value FROM od WHERE matrix_kind = 'DEMAND'

name: Population
definition: Sum of the POP land-use variable over all zones. SQL: SELECT SUM(value) AS value FROM land_use WHERE variable = 'POP'
